steps.name: a simulator is booted
steps.exec: xcrun simctl list devices booted | grep -c Booted

steps.name: Settings is not running yet
steps.comment: Establishes the baseline the tap has to change.
steps.exec: xcrun simctl spawn booted launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep -c com.apple.Preferences || true

steps.name: tap the Settings icon
steps.comment: Device pixels. simctl cannot synthesise a touch, so this is a screen click mapped into the Simulator window.

steps.name: the tap really launched Settings
steps.comment: Read it off the device rather than trusting the screenshot.
steps.exec: xcrun simctl spawn booted launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep -c com.apple.Preferences
